youtube.description:
3 truths nobody tells you about success.

I. The overnight success usually took years.
What looks sudden from the outside was slow and quiet on the inside.

II. "We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit." — Will Durant (summing up Aristotle)
Results are just habits that had time to add up.

III. Most of the work happens when no one is watching.
The early mornings, the repetitions, the drafts nobody sees. That's where it's built.

Which truth hit you the hardest? Comment I, II or III.

Save this for the day you need it, and subscribe for one idea and one reflection to carry through your day. 🌿
